shortBio.en: Judas Priest vocalist 1996–2003 (Jugulator / Demolition) between Halford eras.
shortBio.zh: 1996–2003 Judas Priest 主唱（Jugulator / Demolition），夹在 Halford 两期之间。

body.en:
Born 1967. Replaces Halford for two studio albums. High scream adapted to late-90s Priest production.

Catalog footnote beside British Steel / Painkiller peaks.
body.zh:
1967 年生。接替 Halford 录两张录音室专。高音嘶吼适配 90 年代末 Priest 制作。

相对 British Steel / Painkiller 峰值是目录脚注。
